deviations.what: The pod is an RTX 2000 Ada (sm_89, 16 GB), not the planned 20 GB Ampere A4500.
deviations.consequence: Engine a runs on the native torch._scaled_mm kernel (iteration-4 numerics; the plan's sm_89+ fallback). The exact-math emulation is used only in U1 (validation).

deviations.what: Weight set Q (a, b) runs at B = 20 (exp22's batch shape); weight set B (c, d) at the largest B that fits next to 14.1 GiB of bf16 weights (memory probe; recorded in gpu_b_log.json).
deviations.consequence: Not one B for all engines. Mitigation: U3 shows a row's logits are bitwise identical across batch sizes >= 2-3 in every engine (only B = 1 differs), and the aB control re-runs engine a at weight set B...

deviations.what: Weight set B uses a copy of the vendored sampler whose KV buffer holds `cap` generated tokens (448) and builds each prefill's KV directly into the batch buffer.
deviations.consequence: Bitwise identical for every row that finishes within cap tokens (U6); rows that do not are moved to a full-length buffer and continue in a smaller batch (flagged overflow_at_step).
